requiredBehaviors.behavior: produce a decision-oriented cockpit with owners deadlines risks authority and next steps
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Cockpit Domains and Decision Queue require these fields.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: check information sufficiency before recommending material decisions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Information Sufficiency Gate blocks decision readiness when critical inputs are missing.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: route material decisions into a decision record and follow-up
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Decision Record / Follow-up requires both documentation and implementation tracking.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: turn specialist assessments into automatic board resolutions
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Authority Gate separates assessment, approval and formal organ decisions.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: hide unresolved contradictions or evidence gaps
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Contradictions and openEvidence are explicit Decision Queue fields.
